caption: One 16.7 ms display frame holds exactly two 120 Hz tracker samples, 8.3 ms apart, giving the 2.0 samples per frame computed in worked example 1(a). Notice the two short bars: the second sample is already waiting when the frame is only half over.

spec.aria: Timeline of one 16.7 millisecond display frame carrying two tracker samples, the first at 0 and the second at 8.3 milliseconds, so two samples arrive per frame.
